intro.text: A man who works in the district quartermaster's office and is seeing Drehy of Bridge Four.
A slender Alethi man from the quartermaster's office, married to Drehy of Bridge Four.

items.text: After the Battle of Thaylen Field, Dru boiled bandages for the wounded, his eyes red with grief: Kaladin had come back from Kholinar without Drehy, and Dru believed him dead. Lopen patted his shoulder to comfort him. Dru and Drehy have since married.
